Box"},{"line":3,"text":"// counts are exact integers; an unrepresentable count is a failure, not Infinity."},{"line":4,"text":"function decimal(value) {"},{"line":5,"text":"  const [mantissa, exponent='0']=String(value).split('e'),digits=mantissa.replace('.','')"},{"line":6,"text":"  return {n:BigInt(digits),scale:(mantissa.split('.')[1]?.length||0)-Number(exponent)}"},{"line":7,"text":"}"},{"line":8,"text":"function orderBoxes(current,par,packSize) {"},{"line":9,"text":"  if([current,par,packSize].some(v=>typeof v!=='number'||!Number.isFinite(v))||current<0||par<0||packSize<=0)throw new RangeError('finite nonnegative quantities and a finite positive pack are required')"},{"line":10,"text":"  if(current>=par)return 0"},{"line":11,"text":"  const parts=[current,par,packSize].map(decimal),scale=Math.max(0,...parts.map(p=>p.scale))"},{"line":12,"text":"  const [have,target,pack]=parts.map(p=>p.n*10n**BigInt(scale-p.scale))"},{"line":13,"text":"  const count=(target-have+pack-1n)/pack"},{"line":14,"text":"  if(count>BigInt(Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER))throw new RangeError('box count exceeds safe integer range')"},{"line":15,"text":"  return Number(count)"},{"line":16,"text":"}"},{"line":17,"text":"module.exports={orderBoxes}"},{"line":18,"text":""}]}]},"draftOrigin":{"protocol":"local_case_plan_v1","rawOutputSha256":"a7c46ae5f8f624d879bfe94d7b28e839047dd23418dc51ce11f6e496d217a04f","renderedTestSha256":"5474d2760348aa6cd6ee8e38e34fbf4c1502fe9e37674fccc373a7dbc73cbc10","contractSha256":"74ebb4e2e0c191768ab4e7d0f53a73f001eeddd0db165b38f6593f52c24d15bf","rendererSha256":"98553d3ff2e19d8e60a37cd1c2638ff2c6605a8caa00cf8ecc47228d8c28b1de","testsExecuted":false,"modelAuthoredJavaScript":false},"binding":"41efda397803be9f486335b9d62c62409509266fa7d8fcb9f8ff32456424590f"}"}]}
